'''Andrew Vernon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[March 2001 Smyrna tournament]] on 3 March 2001, according to James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1834">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-smryna-georgia-3-3-01d1834/ smryna-georgia-3-3-01], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-smryna-georgia-3-3-01d1834/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
